يجتذبوا (form VIII)
# يَجْتَذِبُوا (yajtaḏibū) /jad͡ʒ.ta.ði.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# يُجْتَذَبُوا (yujtaḏabū) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ða.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
